items.title: Group shortcut collection tab navigation
items.body:
### Group shortcut collection tab navigation

**Severity:** `medium`

The shortcut items are now individually focusable, but the collection still exposes every item as a separate Tab stop. For manifests with many shortcuts, keyboard users must tab through the entire list before leaving it, even though arrow keys already provide within-list navigation. Set `TabFocusNavigation="Once"` on `MainItemsRepeater` so Tab enters and exits the shortcut collection as one group while preserving arrow-key navigation within the list.
items.outOfDiffReason: The required property belongs on MainItemsRepeater, but the current upstream diff only changes the surrounding ScrollViewer line; there is no safe current RIGHT-side diff anchor for an apply-ready inline suggestion.

confidence.rationale: The latest Copilot review identified the WinUI focus-navigation placement issue, the fork fix moved the property from ScrollViewer to MainItemsRepeater, and the exact candidate built successfully on the pinned upstream head.

prs.testInstructions: Launch <PowerToysCheckout>\x64\Debug\PowerToys.exe, open Shortcut Guide, tab through the search box, close button, navigation rail, and settings control, then verify focus enters a named shortcut card with a system focus visual. Also verify that the proposed MainItemsRepeater TabFocusNavigation="Once" behavior lets Tab enter and exit the collection as one group while arrow keys move between cards.
